name: Photalika
author: Photalika

sections.description:
Unlock the full potential of your WordPress media library with the Photalika plugin. This integration allows you to:

  • Effortlessly upload and synchronize media: Directly upload photos from any device to your WordPress media library through our dedicated app or the intuitive dashboard.
  • Access your media anywhere: Manage and access your entire media collection stored on Photalika from any device.
  • Have all the customization in one place: Edit your images directly on your site with features for resizing, formatting, color adjustments, and applying filters.
  • Find your images instantly: Our robust search engine and image tagging system ensures you find what you need without delay.
  • Collaborate with your team: Facilitate collaboration within your team by granting access to all images.

Key Features:

  • Seamless Integration: Connect your WordPress site to your Photalika account with ease.
  • Direct Upload: Upload media files directly to WordPress media library from any device.
  • Integrated with the Media Library simplifying inserting your images into your posts.

Get Started:

  1. Sign up for a Photalika account: Visit https://photalika.com/ and create your free account.
  2. Install the Photalika plugin: Install the plugin through the WordPress plugin directory or by uploading the ZIP file.
  3. Connect your account: Navigate to the “Photalika” settings page in your WordPress admin area and connect your Photalika account using the access token (available in your Photalika dashboard).
  4. Start using Photalika: Begin uploading media and adding images to your WordPress content.

Configuration

  1. After activating the plugin, a “Photalika” menu item will appear in your Media Library.
  2. Click on “Photalika” to access the plugin settings page.
  3. Enter your Photalika Access Token (found in your Photalika dashboard) and validate.

Usage

Uploading Media:

  • When uploading media through our dedicated app or the Photalika dashboard you can choose the files to save to the WordPress media library.

Support

For support and documentation, please visit https://photalika.com/contact-us/.

External services

This plugin serves as the bridge between your WordPress site and Photalika, a powerful web-based application designed for comprehensive photo management. It leverages the Photalika API to provide a rich service for organizing, storing, and showcasing your photos. By integrating with Photalika, you gain access to robust cloud storage, seamless media synchronization, and advanced photo editions tools, all managed within a dedicated web environment.

To establish and maintain this connection, the plugin securely transmits your media files (photos and associated metadata) to the Photalika web application. It also sends your API credentials (API Key and API Secret) for authentication. In certain instances, your WordPress site URL and plugin version may also be shared to facilitate troubleshooting, provide effective support, and ensure the full functionality of your Photalika-powered media experience.

This service is provided by “Extly, CB”: https://photalika.com/terms-of-service/, https://photalika.com/privacy-policy/.

sections.installation:
1. Navigate to “Plugins” > “Add New” in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Search for “Photalika”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  4. Alternatively, you can download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress.org plugin repository and upload it via “Plugins” > “Add New” > “Upload Plugin”.
sections.faq:
Q: What is Photalika?

A: Photalika is a cloud platform designed for managing, storing, and showcasing your photos. Visit https://photalika.com/ to learn more.

Q: Do I need a Photalika account to use this plugin?

A: Yes, this plugin requires an active Photalika account to function.

Q: Where can I find my Photalika Access Token?

A: You can find your Access Token in your Photalika dashboard after logging into your account on https://photalika.com/.

Q: What happens to my media if I uninstall the plugin?

A: Uninstalling the plugin will not remove your media files saved to your Media Library or from your Photalika account. However, the connection between your WordPress site and Photalika will be severed.
